correctness.rationale: Reconstructed D=im(Box) as a bounded sublattice, Box as the largest D-below operator preserving joins by the strong hypothesis and preserving meets by maximality. Finite Birkhoff duality gives Box(U)=f^{-1}(U), with contractivity equivalent to f(x)<=x and idempotence to f^2=f. Each x has f(x)=greatest(S intersect down(x)), so all minimal A1 points are fixed; for each omitted x in layer j, highest lower occupied fixed layer must have exactly one point. This uniquely determines the map. The disjoint singleton/multiple top-layer transitions are n=1:(2s+m,0), n>=2:((n+1)s,(2^n-n-1)s+m) for labeled maps and (2s,(n-1)s+m) for level-permutation orbits. The uniform (1,m^t) formulas follow by geometric sums. I independently enumerated all 127 positive compositions of at most seven points, derived isotone idempotent counts without invoking the attached verifier, and matched the recurrence; finite enumeration only checks finite cases.

value.rationale: Strong subresiduation is an established algebraic-logical operation, while fixed finite distributive lattices over ordinal sums of antichains form an infinite natural family. The two-state recurrences compress exponential fixed-subset enumeration to O(h) arithmetic transitions and identify exact algebra-isomorphism orbit counts, beyond the known generic image-set criterion. This is a motivated complete census, not a claim that the generic retraction theorem or integer sequences are new.

final_claim: Finite strong subresiduated expansions of the upset lattice of every ordinal sum of nonempty antichains correspond bijectively to regressive isotone idempotents on the dual poset, and their labeled and isomorphism-orbit totals satisfy the exact two-state recurrences and uniform-width closed forms in RESULT.md.
limitations: Finite P only; n_i >=1; expansions of fixed Up(P), not all algebras of a cardinality.
Arithmetic-operation O(h) excludes integer bit complexity.
Bounded map enumeration does not replace the quantified duality proof.
